name: Joe Lorch Scuppernong Vineyard
description: Joe Lorch Scuppernong Vineyard grows Apples, Corn, Grapes, Honey, and Eggs in 43717 Rummage Road, NC. The farm is small, and its seasons run through autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
